name: Ri○ de Nikushoku no Dorei Gangu
original_name: Ri○ de 肉蝕の奴隷玩具
source:
Welcome to the Howard Resort casino!

Blackjack, roulette, slots...
It's a place of dazzling brilliance, where days and nights of joys and sorrows blend together.
People dream of quick riches, people gamble joyously, and people come to see the wiggle of the dealer's bunny tail.

Rio is the top dealer, with a zeal and heart for her work.
But the owner of the resort, the scheming Howard, has a devious trick in mind...

Reality falls apart!

They seem just like regular goods, but they are "Flesh" slave toys...
Tentacles spring forth from "Tentacle" slave toys...
The reality that Rio and the other girls knew is completely shattered!

translation:
欢迎来到霍华德度假村赌场！

二十一点、轮盘赌、老虎机……
这是一个光彩夺目的地方，欢乐与悲伤的日日夜夜交融在一起。
人们梦想着快速致富，人们快乐地赌博，人们来看荷官的兔子尾巴的摆动。

里奥是顶级经销商，对工作充满热情和热情。
但度假村的老板、诡计多端的霍华德却想施诡计……

现实分崩离析！

看似普通的商品，却是“肉体”的奴隶玩具……
触手从“触手”奴隶玩具中伸出……
里奥她们所认知的现实彻底破灭了！
